entries.reason: The data ramp is one palette of eight steps (docs/kiro-design-system.md → Data ramp, pinned whole by theme/chartRamp.test.ts): a series or category takes its step by index, so the utility mapping stays complete even while only steps 1-3 are written as utilities (SocialFeed). Tailwind emits nothing for an unused utility, so the kept mappings cost no CSS.
